messages:
olivia: Quick design pass—new idea: collapse stop+regen into a compact action menu on hover instead of two separate buttons. Keeps chrome minimal during long streams. Link to mock: https://figma.com/file/new/playground-minimal

raj: I like minimal chrome but worried about discoverability. Maybe show a transient pill that says "Streaming... (press Esc to stop)" that expands on hover to actions.

mia: UX nit: if we hide stop behind a menu, keyboard users might miss it. Ensure a dedicated focusable element and a shortcut (Esc to stop).

kevin: a11y: whichever pattern, Stop must be exposed in DOM order early and have aria-label="Stop generation". For menu approach, ensure menu button has aria-haspopup and proper keyboard handling. Streaming text needs aria-live="polite".

alisa: QA: confirm that compact token badge doesn't float over selection handles. On mobile, tokens should be in the header not on top of bubble. Add tests for selection + actions.

olivia: proposal details: 1) transient streaming banner above conversation: "Streaming 32 tok7. Esc to stop" 2) hover menu on message with "Regenerate" and "Stop" 3) token badge in top-left of streamer area, keyboard focus expands to full label.

raj: microcopy: show "Tokens: 832 (est.)" when expanded. Tooltip: "Estimated tokens used so far". Regen label: "Regenerate response".

kevin: implement debounce for token updates (~300ms) and respect prefers-reduced-motion for any pulses. Announce pinned prompt actions via aria-live: "Prompt pinned".

mia: prompt library pin UX: double-action: drag-to-pin for mouse users, and a small "Pin" keyboard action in the card menu. That keeps parity.

ux-bot: automated screenshot posted: https://img.redwood.dev/minimal_stream_banner.png

alisa: test plan items: keyboard stop via Esc, focus order for menu, token badge tooltip keyboard focus, mobile header token placement, drag-to-pin keyboard fallback. Add to TKT-1088.

olivia: votes: react with :one: for transient banner + hover menu, :two: for always-visible inline controls.

raj: :one: (banner + menu)

kevin: :one: but insist on explicit keyboard affordance and aria labels in PR.

mia: :one: adding keyboard pin flow to figma.

alisa: adding tests and will pair with sam for e2e.

olivia: decision: go with transient streaming banner with compact token badge and hover menu for actions; provide keyboard shortcuts and accessible menu alternative. Action items: raj -> prototype banner + menu, kevin -> a11y checklist, alisa -> test cases, mia -> update figma. Target: next minor release. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
